Before drawing causal conclusions inspect capture completeness, reasons, issues, analysisBlocked and unresolved associations separately. causalConsistency=no-detected-inconsistency alone is not a completeness or attribution pass.
A readId0 is valid for non-SWR calls; a target SWR action without a read association remains not-attributed. Do not label all readless actions as collection loss or invent read IDs.
Do not turn observed key/channel sets or all matching prior invalidation candidates into a unique causal edge. Exact action/read/request proofs are stronger than those contextual sets.

Dispatch barriers are client lower bounds immediately before fetch, not observed server snapshot times. Open, ready and returned response completion cannot replace the actual source freshness conditions.
Retain legitimate in-flight operations at the final cut. Do not wait to settle them, change windows, subtract diagnostic reads from budgets, or claim the uninstrumented441/331 acceptance changed.
